Stock market news | Sensex down nearly 2% as ₹5 lakh crore wiped

On 23 November 2026, Sensex and Nifty dropped nearly 2%, wiping out more than ₹5 lakh crore in investor wealth. Profit booking after a strong rally triggered the sell-off, with banking stocks falling sharply.

The decline erased gains from the biggest Nifty surge in six years and shows how quickly profit-taking can reverse market sentiment, affecting retail investors' portfolios.
